title: The EU Battery Regulation and Digital Product Passports: What You Need to Know Before February 2027
subtitle: A practical guide to battery passport obligations under Regulation 2023/1542 — who needs one, what data is required, and how to prepare
excerpt: The EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 introduces mandatory Digital Product Passports for industrial, EV, and LMT batteries from February 2027. This guide covers who needs a battery passport, what data must be included, the carbon footprint declaration timeline, and how to start preparing now.
